title: Twenty Thousand Leagues under the Sea
sourceTitle: Twenty Thousand Leagues under the Sea
author: Jules Verne
description: "Twenty Thousand Leagues under the Sea" by Jules Verne is a science fiction adventure novel serialized from 1869 to 1870.
longDescription: When ships worldwide report encounters with a mysterious sea monster, an American expedition sets out to destroy it. Professor Aronnax, harpooner Ned Land, and servant Conseil discover the creature is actually a futuristic submarine commanded by the enigmatic Captain Nemo.

authorInfo.bio: Jules Verne (1828–1905) is the credited author of this historical edition. Works available in this collection include Around the World in Eighty Days, A Journey to the Centre of the Earth, The Mysterious Island, From the Earth to the moon; and, round the moon. The linked author record provides further bibliographic details.
